verdict.rationale: The Labour and Employment page lists "employee compensation and benefits structuring" and "bespoke remuneration models", and the Knowledge Repository includes an ESOP-buyback tax analysis. That suggests adjacent expertise, but no page explicitly says the firm designs option plans or ESOP schemes. The firm is India-only, so Indian ESOPs are the only relevant local scheme. Missing for 10: a dedicated page describing employee equity or ESOP plan design, explicit option-plan drafting services, coverage of non-Indian schemes such as UK EMI or German VSOP, and independent corroboration.
